newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BCP boosts H1 commissions.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BCP boosts H1 commissions.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Comercial Portugues boosted consolidated net commissions in the first half of 1997 by 40 percent to 19.459 billion escudos, compared with the same period of 1996, dealers said.
Rui Lopes, a senior BCP official, told reporters the commissions included 1.5 billion escudos from the first stage privatisation of utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal in June.
Earlier, BCP reported a 21 percent increase in consolidated first half net profit to 13.121 billion escudos.
